fact: The NBS microdata catalogue released the Integrated Labour Force Survey 2025 (14,232 households, fieldwork January to December 2025, 99.63 percent response) on 15 July 2026 as edited final data for public use, with a 2026 NBS key-indicators report cited.

The ILFS 2025 sampling frame was derived from the inventory of enumeration areas compiled during the 2022 Population and Housing Census; the document gives no enumeration date, so the year 2022 is used.
The article refers to voter-eligibility estimates derived from the 2022 Population and Housing Census, showing a census was counted in 2022; it gives no enumeration date, so the year is used.
The deck gives Tanzania's population as 61.7 million from the 2022 census.
A TCRA presentation gives Tanzania's 2022 census population as 61,741,120 and 14,152,803 private households, with ICT indicators from the census.
